Kernel of the binomial power prior on blocks of risk differences

Source: R/binomial_lattice_fast.R
lattice_kernel_blocks.Rd

For each block of risk differences k, the matrix kernel[j, k] = sum_i w(i - j) a_i b_{i+k} over the target control rates j of target_rows that keep j + k on the lattice for some k of the block, with i over the source rows source_rows. The source rows are restricted the same way: b is zero off the lattice, so the rows left out contribute nothing.

Usage

lattice_kernel_blocks(
  source_control,
  source_treatment,
  source_rows,
  target_rows,
  differences,
  block,
  consume
)

Arguments

source_control

The discounted source control likelihood a, zero on the source control rates left out.

source_treatment

The discounted source treatment likelihood b.

source_rows, target_rows

Ranges c(lowest, highest) of source and target control rate indices.

differences

Risk differences, consecutive, in lattice units.

block

Number of risk differences per block.

consume

A function of the block (as from lattice_difference_blocks(), with target_first and target_last) and its kernel, called once per non-empty block.

Value

NULL, invisibly.
